SELECT 
  t1.category AS 品类,
  t1.brand AS 品牌,
  t1.total_amount AS 销售额
FROM (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    dp.brand,
    SUM(fo.order_amount) AS total_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dp.category ORDER BY SUM(fo.order_amount) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_order fo
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
  WHERE dd.year = 2025
  GROUP BY dp.category, dp.brand
) t1
WHERE t1.rn = 1

SELECT 
  d.month,
  SUM(f.order_amount) AS current_month_sales,
  LAG(SUM(f.order_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY d.year, d.month) AS previous_month_sales,
  SUM(f.order_amount) - LAG(SUM(f.order_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY d.year, d.month) AS month_on_month_growth
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.year, d.month
ORDER BY d.year, d.month

SELECT 
  dp.brand,
  SUM(fo.order_amount) AS brand_sales,
  SUM(SUM(fo.order_amount)) OVER() AS total_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(fo.order_amount) / SUM(SUM(fo.order_amount)) OVER() * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dp.brand
ORDER BY brand_sales DESC
